comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsourced services provider paid a revenue share by partner universities; it doesn't operate institutions or bill students tuition directly.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit nursing and allied health colleges funded by tuition and student aid, matching Rasmussen's business, though smaller and regional.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Operates for-profit, mostly online universities for adult learners on Title IV tuition, including health sciences programs.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults with military and employer channels, funded by tuition and federal aid.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly online K-12 curriculum and virtual school management paid by public school funding, not postsecondary tuition.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: For-profit postsecondary career and technical schools on tuition and Title IV aid, similar to APEI's career education campuses.
